title: 10 Prompting Techniques My Deep Learning Exam Taught Me (That I Actually Use Now)
why_read: A fairly basic overview of named prompting techniques that most experienced LLM users already know, with limited new technical depth.
analysis: The article catalogs common prompt engineering patterns like zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and tree-of-thought prompting, reframed with developer-relevant examples instead of textbook ones. This is useful as an accessible primer for engineers newer to working with LLMs, but it doesn't present new research, benchmarks, or non-obvious insights. Anyone who has already worked with prompting strategies in production will find little new here. It reads more as a study-notes summary than an original technical contribution.
